items.note: These are the sort of curated, specialist selections that I created 'Back Announce' for in the first place. Fracture throws down an hour of crunchy, experimental bass, jungle and DnB, on the mic the whole time to share deets on what we're listening to.
An excellent selection of upbeat bass, dubstep and DnB from across the spectrum, a killer source of new bottom-heavy tunes and one of my weekly favourites.

I've always loved hip hop, but I've also always found it difficult to keep up with (particularly during the 2010s when there was so much happening). So this show from Benji B is like a beautiful gift. 2hrs of hip hop, future beats and RnB. Benji B curates this weekly show like a consumate professional.

I'm a longtime fan of heavy music and still love to dip in occasionally (when I'm not distracted by electronic stuff), so it's a lot of fun to jump into this. 

The standard of the triple j specialist shows is really high! It's the type of radio curation that I used to take for granted growing up.
